generation.scope: Branching requires a decomposable relation in the three-dimensional contraction space of an actual center. For finite pure-relation schemes all center pencils have a single Veronese block of degree zero to three and cyclic regular blocks, at most two centers per phase. Excess rank-drop contact at the start of a two-line corridor forces a length-two pure subscheme on its middle edge.

open_mathematics: Use the excess-contact obstruction, the local defect lengths and exhaustive corridor constraints for a single reduced pure relation, then treat higher-length and positive-dimensional pure schemes. Finite stable windows still require separate all-degree analysis.
